outcome: homeostatic model assessment of insulin resistance (HOMA-IR)
cohort: The study included 35 singleton, consecutive pregnant women with GDM and a control group of 40 healthy women with uncomplicated pregnancies, matched for body mass index and age.
finding: NLR levels were higher and LMR levels were lower in pregnant women with GDM compared with healthy women, suggesting that systemic inflammation is associated with GDM independently of maternal BMI and weight gain during pregnancy.
